name: StadiumMatchdayIncidentLog
tagline: Event-control incident log for stadiums – dispatch, escalate and report every matchday incident.
description: A complete event-control app for sports venues in one Power Apps component: log incidents by stand, block or gate with severity, dispatch steward, medical and police-liaison teams against per-severity targets, record escalations, watch the live queue, stadium map, dispatch board and matchday timeline, and produce the post-event report.
features: Live queue by severity with dispatch timers
Dispatch targets per severity with overdue badges
Lifecycle rules: team before dispatch, outcome before resolve, escalation for critical, casualties and arrests
Stadium map coloured by most severe open incident
Drag-and-drop dispatch board with allowed transitions only
Post-event report with copy-to-clipboard and CSV export
Demo mode with a fictional live matchday
Phone layout with bottom view bar
